subject.title: fix(tui): handle live session message updates

question: Should maintainers accept the remaining TUI session-state ordering risk and land this live selected-session refresh fix?
rationale: The patch appears correct and proved, but it intentionally changes visible transcript refresh timing in a stateful TUI path where maintainer review is the right final gate.

options.title: Land after session-state review
options.body: Accept the bounded session-state risk because the PR uses the existing Gateway event contract, preserves one reload owner, and includes focused plus live validation evidence.

options.title: Request stronger visible proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or recording if the narrative live proof is not enough for this stateful UI path.

options.title: Hold for broader observer direction
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want to fold selected-session live refresh into the separate cross-channel observer product decision.

recommendation.title: Land after session-state review
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded session-state risk because the PR uses the existing Gateway event contract, preserves one reload owner, and includes focused plus live validation evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is assigned, authored the latest rewrite commits, and shows the strongest recent ownership of the touched TUI and Gateway event paths.
